| TunerStudio label | Setting | Units | Range | Help (as TunerStudio shows it) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Instantaneous injector duty cycle limit | `maxInjectorDutyInstant` | % | 50 … 200 | This sets an immediate limit on injector duty cycle. If this threshold is reached, the system will immediately cut the injectors. |
| Sustained injector duty cycle limit | `maxInjectorDutySustained` | % | 50 … 120 | This limit allows injectors to operate up to the specified duty cycle percentage for a short period (as defined by the delay). After this delay, if the duty cycle remains above the limit, it will trigger a cut. |
| Sustained injector duty cycle delay | `maxInjectorDutySustainedTimeout` | sec | 0 … 5 | Timeout period for duty cycle over the sustained limit to trigger duty cycle protection. |
